_comment: Stone Statue collection: Pokémon as solid stone statues. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed stone-statue-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Stone Statues
readme.summary: Pokemon turned into solid, weathered stone statues.
looks: granite-grey stone with the markings kept as carved relief
stone grain, speckles, chisel strokes, chipped edges, cracks and the odd patch of moss and lichen
blank carved eyes; no glow (flames become carved stone)
shiny: polished white marble with grey veins and gold-leaf eyes
